Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Goal/state: Explore PEAK offline and travel inland/uphill from SHORE toward the peak. Gate 7 boarding and loading are complete; do not repeat loading workarounds. No expedition terminal state has occurred.

Current observed position: SHORE/DAY ONE. The player is against a tall pale rock face, looking steeply upward with a pink hand visibly touching/gripping it. No ledge or interaction prompt is visible. Stamina has fallen below half during repeated 1-second W+J holds. The stamina drain and hand reach indicate climbing-related input is active, but actual upward progress is not clearly confirmed; the current section could be blocked or movement may be too subtle to judge. This remains uncertain.

Observed route/navigation: Initial W/W+Shift movement climbed the beach through tall grass toward palms. Repeated W+Space, W+D+Shift, and W+J failed to clear a steep sandy/rock rise. Backing away with S+Right exposed open beach to its right; moving right, then diagonally forward-right, successfully bypassed it. An open palm-lined sandy path led toward pale rock pillars and a darker cliff. W+Space cleared a fallen palm trunk across this path. The current pale wall has a sloping approach/open ground on its left and palms/coastline on its right. W+J while approaching mostly closed the distance; at contact it produced no obvious ascent. Adding Up pitched the view upward and produced a visible reach onto the rock followed by continuing stamina drain.

Failed/current hypotheses: Ordinary walking, sprinting, jumping, diagonal sprinting, and W+J alone did not clear the first steep rise. Upward aim may be required to grip/climb the pale wall, but this is not fully established. Continuing W+J was hypothesized to ascend; after several holds, stamina consumption is clear but height gain and a reachable top are not. Do not treat the wall as definitely traversable.

Inventory: Slot 1 FORTIFIED MILK, slot 2 ENERGY DRINK, slot 3 GUIDEBOOK, slot 4 equipped BACKPACK; all items stowed and hands otherwise free. Milk was not consumed. Guidebook cover: “WILDERNESS HANDBOOK, VOLUME 1,” by Scoutmaster Myres. Backpack storage is untested; its radial menu had four blank upper sectors and a lower backpack-icon sector, and the upper sectors are only guessed to be storage.

Learned controls/mechanics: W/A/S/D move; Left/Right turn; Up/Down pitch view. W+Shift_L sprints and drains stamina; walking/waiting allows recovery. W+Space jumps. E is contextual interact/pickup. Tab stows a held item while retaining its inventory icon. Number 4 toggles the backpack between held/stowed. Avoid Q: prompts identify Q as drop and holding it as throw. Mouse-look required corrections; close range and precise crosshair aim matter.

Containers/pickups: BIG LUGGAGE only showed E open nearby. Brief E taps did nothing; sustained E filled a circular ring and opened it. Pickups similarly needed close aim and roughly a one-second E hold. Fortified Milk and the green-and-white Energy Drink were collected and stowed, leaving the suitcase empty. Its orange marking appeared to be a sticker. Holding E on the ground backpack opened its radial menu; aiming downward highlighted “wear backpack,” and clicking equipped it into slot 4.

Unresolved tests/observations: Guidebook showed open/close/page prompts, but brief J, brief K, and a one-second K hold caused no visible opening; contents and correct input remain unknown. Airport passport right-mouse open tests similarly had no visible effect. Airport tower W+J, W+Space, and holding J by a red hold produced no ascent. Chess E removed a rook and its prompt without a visible inventory icon; effect unconfirmed. Airport boarding originally succeeded near the queue via “Gate Kiosk — E board flight,” followed by the PEAK pass and START. Play Offline initially had a Photon failure, but the expedition is now loaded.
